source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: 66 native observations; all 66 accepted full-LCD/status key replays as of beta.28. Two LineI history viewport frames previously excluded were restored after the general history renderer matched their full LCD/status. JSON saved directly to project.

Prime factorization: 360=2^3*3^2*5, 4104676=2^2*(1026169), 2^30. Multi-digit exponents use small script in MathI and bold compact digits in LineI; explicit Standard clears factorization. FORMAT alone leaves factorization visible. 1 and 1e10 have no prime option.

Engineering notation opens a temporary adjustment mode: left/right change exponent by 3, up/down ignored, EXE/OK/Back keep presentation and remove adjustment arrows. Reopening starts from canonical exponent (one step lower when Engineer Symbol is on); Standard clears presentation. MathI/LineI, negatives and k/micro/p measured.

Engineer Symbol on suppresses fraction, recurring and prime FORMAT entries. Engineering is absent for zero; selecting option 3 at zero selects DMS. Three initially named symbol-engineering frames selected DMS option 4 instead and are renamed to match the observed actions; all match, no assumed ENG expectation.

The right engineering adjustment stops before integer mantissa exceeds ten digit cells; blocked arrow is hidden. Independent repeat at 12500000p confirms another right press has no effect. Extreme exponent/leading-zero left limits are not yet measured.

PLUS DMS rounds seconds to two decimal places, half away from zero. 0.045sec displays 0.05sec; 0.0449sec displays 0.04sec; independently repeated from HOME. 0.0000125 degrees converts to 0deg0min0.05sec. Legacy 580 retains its rounding path.
